project-token.note: Select the intended project. Save HETZNER_PROJECT_TOKEN in the protected file.

storage-keys.note: Save STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY and STORAGE_SECRET_KEY. Review access to the private state bucket, with versioning.

bucket.note: Bucket creation and versioning need separate approval. Preflight only reads the selected bucket.

leftovers.menu_path: Project > Servers, Firewalls, SSH keys, Volumes, Load Balancers, Primary IPs, Floating IPs, Images, Object Storage and DNS
leftovers.note: Review snapshot and backup images, including retained copies. Object Storage and DNS remain outside the Cloud inventory. Each deletion needs separate approval. Keep encrypted state and its key for recovery.

auth-key.field: Expiry: one day; Reusable: off; Ephemeral: off; Pre-approved: on; Tags: tag:server; Key
auth-key.note: Save TAILSCALE_AUTH_KEY. Single use, persistent node. Never reuse this key.

read-credential.field: General > Services: Read; Policy File: Read; DNS: Read; Networking settings: Read; Devices > Core: Read and Posture attributes: Read; Client ID; Client secret
read-credential.note: Recommended. Save TAILSCALE_READ_CLIENT_ID and TAILSCALE_READ_CLIENT_SECRET. Policy File: Read requires both device read scopes. Networking settings: Read reads HTTPS certificates. No write scopes. The kit exchanges these for a short-lived token with only the reads needed by the command.

access-token.note: Fallback TAILSCALE_API_TOKEN carries the creating user's full API permissions, including permitted writes and deletions. It is not read-only. Revoke it after setup.

docktail-credential.field: General > Services: Write with tag:container; Devices > Core: Write with tag:server; Client ID; Client secret
docktail-credential.note: Save TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and TAILSCALE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET. This write credential belongs to docktail, never to preflight. Creation needs separate approval.

policy.note: Merge the printed policy lines into the existing policy only after your own review and approval. The kit never saves policy.

dns.note: Each change needs your approval. Certificate names enter public Certificate Transparency logs.

oauth-leftover.menu_path: Settings > Trust credentials > the place docktail and read credentials
oauth-leftover.note: Check both credentials, if created. Revocation also revokes their active access tokens.

token-leftover.menu_path: Settings > Keys > API access tokens > the setup token
token-leftover.note: Revoke the fallback full-permission API token after setup, if created.

claim.field: Your own administrator account and password
claim.note: You have ten minutes after restart. Skip setup avoids unrecorded wizard resources. Password goes only into Coolify.

two-factor.note: Keep recovery codes separately. Passkeys are unavailable on this plain HTTP IP address.

api-access.menu_path: Settings > Advanced > Access and API > API and MCP > API access
api-access.note: Leave the built-in MCP server off; this recipe uses the pinned stdio package.

team-token.field: Description; Expires in; Permissions: Read, Write, Deploy, Read sensitive data, never Root or Delete; Access > Resources: All resources in the team; Copy your token
team-token.note: Never Root or Delete. Save COOLIFY_TEAM_TOKEN in the protected file.

docktail-variables.field: Value; Runtime: on; Build time: off; production (not preview)
docktail-variables.note: The approved oauth-id and oauth-secret stages normally set these. Manual edits need separate approval; never print either value.

destination.button: Select the coolify Standalone Docker destination
destination.note: Read existing identities only. Do not create a server or destination.
